name: What is the process for hiring Maine Results, Inc. for wall molding installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring Maine Results, Inc. for wall molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with a consultation to discuss your vision, assess your space, and understand your preferences for molding style and materials. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, timeline, and cost. Once approved, our skilled team schedules the installation at your convenience. We handle all aspects from preparation to a clean finish, including removal of old molding if necessary, precise cutting and fitting, secure installation, and preparation for painting. Our goal is to ensure a smooth, professional experience from initial contact to project completion, delivering high-quality results for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation and proposal, followed by professional installation at your convenience, covering all steps from preparation to finish. We ensure a smooth, high-quality experience.
